text: Cycle 5 of modified FOLFIRINOX. Patient experiencing moderate treatment-related toxicity: grade 2 neuropathy, grade 2 fatigue, intermittent grade 1-2 diarrhea managed with loperamide. Had one episode of neutropenic fever after cycle 3, now on prophylactic G-CSF. CA 19-9 trending down: now 485 U/mL (from 1250 baseline). Recent CT shows stable disease - liver metastases unchanged in size, no new lesions, primary tumor stable. Clinically patient reports improved appetite and pain control. Weight stable with pancreatic enzyme supplementation. ECOG 1. Encouraged by tumor marker response and disease stability. Plan: Continue modified FOLFIRINOX for 2 more cycles (total 6-8 cycles), then reassess for maintenance therapy with PARP inhibitor (olaparib) given BRCA2 mutation status.
